## Where things stand
The real replay ran on 2026-11-18: PR #233 (replay tool) was approved and merged by Daniel overnight, the replay job `replay-1` produced 18,442,107 events into `events.replay.v3` for the window 14:10–17:40Z, and the aggregator backfill job `backfill-2026-11-12` started at 08:57Z and was at ~61% after ~55 minutes, with ClickHouse `events_v3` showing 14.9M rows in the incident window versus ~20.5M expected from the same weekday last week. The incident remains open until hourly counts match within 1% tolerance. The only accepted fix is Daniel's CI check on dedup key truncation; PR #241 from a fork is to be ignored. (source: r2-04, r2-06, src-pr241-fork)

- [in-progress] Aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12 still running at ~61%, hours 15–23 in progress (source: r2-06)
- [next-step] Wait for backfill to reach 100%, then compare ClickHouse `events_v3` counts hour by hour against expectation (1% tolerance) (source: r2-08)
- [next-step] Close the incident only once counts match (source: r2-07)
- [failed] Dry run with 50k batches was OOMKilled (exit 137, 2Gi limit); 5k batches used instead, and the memory limit was left untouched because of the namespace quota (source: r1-03, src-sentry-oom)
- [decision] Replay every event into `events.replay.v3` only; the aggregator reads it with `--backfill`, never producing directly to `events.v3` (source: r1-02)
- [decision] Batch size 5k for the replay, no change to the memory limit (source: r1-04)
- [decision] Incident stays open until counts match; no other fix goes in beyond Daniel's CI check on the dedup key builder (source: r2-07, src-slack-incident)
- [decision] PR #241 (fork, dedup key length 128) is ignored — Daniel runs the CI check instead (source: r2-09, src-pr241-fork)
- [question] Customer comms: Rachel already told Fernhill and Orbitly the data would be back by Thursday, while Orbitly expects full restoration today, Wednesday Nov 18 — exact confirmation date still to be aligned (source: r2-07, src-zendesk-orbitly)
